answers.ask: What kind of street: a downtown high street, a quiet suburb, a school neighbourhood?
answers.answer: Make it a small downtown high street with streetwear shops and a modern city feel.

answers.ask: Should players be able to go inside the shops and buildings, or is it all street level?
answers.answer: Players should be able to enter the main streetwear shops for outfits; keep the rest of the buildings street level.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do besides hang out and dress up, like jobs or roles?
answers.answer: No extra jobs or roles are needed; the game is for hanging out, roleplaying, and dressing up in streetwear outfits.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D roleplay map set on a small downtown high street with a modern city feel. A walkable main street is lined with street-level buildings; the main streetwear shops are enterable for outfit browsing, while the remaining buildings form a street-facing backdrop.
agent_notes: A roleplay hangout where the personalization is the outfit and nothing is owned is settlement-static by definition, so Morph Roleplay is the preset — the genre warns against assuming a plot, and the author confirmed there are no jobs, roles or houses, just hanging out and dressing up. I added path-street on top of the preset because the street is half of what the prompt actually asked for, and building-interior because the author said outright that players enter the main streetwear shops, which makes P3 a stated feature rather than an assumption; the answer also caps it, so only those shops are enterable and the rest stay facades. I left out path-road-vehicle since no vehicles were mentioned and the genre says not to apply 15- and 30-stud widths to a walking-only town. Downtown streetwear styling comes from the theme answer and bends the landmark and photo spots toward shopfronts rather than adding picks.
